applicant.organisation: Gesundheit Österreich GmbH (national public health institute), alcohol policy unit

purpose: For the ministry's alcohol policy review we are analysing the links between alcohol, obesity and type 2 diabetes and need regional diabetes prevalence.
question: How many adults have type 2 diabetes, per region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes.
